description_zh: 一辆丰田卡罗拉以约6英里/小时速度右转进入公园入口时，转弯过宽，越过车道中心线，撞上对向车道静止的苹果测试车。苹果测试车停在左转车道准备离开公园。

source_snippets: On September 19th, 2019 at 7:58am an Apple test vehicle... was struck while stopped in the left turn lane preparing to exit the Sunnyvale Community Center Park onto Manet Drive.

The Apple test vehicle was stopped when the Toyota Corolla, traveling at approximately 6 mph, swung wide outside of its lane while making a right turn into the Sunnyvale Community Center Park entrance from Manet Drive and struck the Apple test vehicle.
evidence.reason: 选择移动的丰田卡罗拉作为ego，因其右转时偏离车道导致碰撞，具有测试价值。苹果测试车静止在左转车道，作为NPC位于对向车道。
